description.en: An ontology for capturing, sharing, and reusing verification data from test trench excavations (proefsleuven) in the Netherlands.
description.nl: Versie 1.0 richt zich op veldwaarnemingen in proefsleuven, ruimtelijke metingen, ondersteunend bewijs en herkomst. Detectie van KLIC-afwijkingen valt buiten deze versie.

Elevation of the utility reference point relative to NAP, in
    meters. Source of truth for depth.

scopeNote.value:
Both diepteNAP and diepteTovMaaiveld are retained because NAP
    elevation is the stable registration value that survives surface changes, while
    depth-of-cover relative to ground level is the value contractors actually collect and
    record in DXF deliveries. IMKL carries both. Removing depth-of-cover would leave the
    database empty wherever a contractor records only cover, while removing NAP would make
    values non-comparable across sites with different surface levels.

comment.en:

    Amsterdams Peil), in meters.

definition.value: Omtrek van de bodem van de proefsleuf.
Outline of the floor of the test trench.

comment.en:
The excavation floor outline, as distinct from the ground
    level outline carried by utt:sleufGeometrie. Added in v0.4 because contractor drawings
    deliver both outlines and a single geometry property cannot say which is which. The pair
    gives the excavated volume rather than only a footprint, and the floor level records how
    far the excavation actually reached, which is the exclusion evidence for utilities that
    could have been present but were not found.
